light_description: Compact fuzz designed for thick saturated tones with a punchy, direct response.
High-octave fuzz with a strong upper-octave character and saturated fuzz foundation.
Dual-voice octave fuzz combining a broad fuzz mode with an aggressive high-octave stinger voice.
Fuzz harmonizer combining saturated fuzz with layered pitch voices for dense and animated dirt textures.
Blendable fuzz and overdrive pedal allowing the two dirt voices to be mixed for thicker or more articulate gain.
Mid-gain overdrive designed for responsive amplifier-style breakup and warm, harmonically rich drive.
Compact overdrive voiced for tube-like breakup, moving from lighter drive into thicker gain.
Dual-mode drive pedal covering vintage-style crunch through richer overdrive and a dedicated fuzz voice.
Three-voice fuzz inspired by Brazilian psychedelic textures, ranging from distinct vintage fuzz colors to thicker saturation.
Dual-channel overdrive combining two distinct drive voices with selectable options and flexible series routing.
Germanium booster designed as a versatile gain stage for adding volume, harmonic color and amplifier drive.
FET-based amplifier-in-a-box pedal offering clean boost, overdrive and fuzz with two-band EQ and rich harmonic response.
Germanium-enhanced version of the Benson Preamp, combining a lower-gain response with rich overdrive, boost and fuzz textures.

Germanium Tone Bender MkI-style fuzz with a vintage-oriented saturated response.

Dual overdrive combining two gain sections for flexible low-to-medium gain sounds and stacked drive.
Dual-purpose boost and buffer designed to preserve signal clarity while providing additional level and amplifier push.
Responsive overdrive designed for articulate amplifier-style breakup and usable gain across the control range.
Single-channel overdrive designed for articulate low-to-medium gain and amp-pushing applications.
High-gain overdrive with a forceful saturated response and strong note definition.
Fuzz pedal built around thick saturation and expressive harmonic texture.
Compact distortion with a saturated, aggressive voice designed for heavier gain applications.
Limited-edition fuzz/distortion combining thick saturation with an aggressive, dark gain character.

Fuzz pedal with a dense, aggressive voice aimed at saturated and sustaining textures.

Mutant D+ and 250-style distortion with symmetrical/asymmetrical red-LED clipping and expanded low-frequency response.

Analog fuzz designed for extreme, heavy saturation and dense distorted textures.
